newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Simione Central Holdings.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Simione Central Holdings.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist said it has started coverage of Simione Central Holdings Inc, a maker of information systems for home healthcare, with a buy rating.
-- In written research, the investment firm said Simione is "a clear leader" in its market sector with "an outstanding market opportunity."

-- Hambrecht forecasts 30 to 35 percent top-line growth and 50 percent plus earning growth over the next two to three years. It estimates earning per share of $0.32 in 1997, $0.63 a share in 1998 and $0.94 a share in 1999.
-- Simione shares were up 3/4 at 12-5/8 by mid-afternoon.
